description: You are an epidemiologist investigating a mumps outbreak. The Mumps dataset (C:\EpiInfo7\Projects\Mumps\Mumps.mdb, table: Survey) contains individual-level case and contact data including vaccination status, illness status, age, and other demographic variables. Your tasks are: (1) Read the Mumps Survey dataset into Classic Analysis. (2) Run a frequency analysis on all relevant variables to understand the dataset structure and distribution. (3) Create a 2x2 table of vaccination status versus illness outcome to compute crude odds ratio. (4) Run a multivariable logistic regression with illness as the outcome and vaccination status as the primary predictor, controlling for age group and other relevant covariates available in the dataset. (5) Save the complete output to C:\Users\Docker\mumps_analysis.html using ROUTEOUT. (6) Write a summary CSV with variable names and their effect estimates (OR, 95% CI) to C:\Users\Docker\mumps_ve_summary.csv using WRITE. Vaccine effectiveness is calculated as VE = (1 - OR) x 100%.

metadata.primary_outcome: illness indicator variable in the Mumps Survey dataset
metadata.primary_exposure: vaccination status variable in the Mumps Survey dataset
covariates: other demographic variables present in dataset
